title: Xuanzang's western pilgrimage route
subtitle: A schematic of transregional knowledge movement from Chang'an
shortSummary: The route places Chang'an, the Hexi Corridor, Central Asia and South Asia in one research view without treating every node as a verified day-by-day itinerary.
curatorialDescription: The route is a composite read model of biography, historical geography and later maps; each node retains its own evidence layer and confidence.
The real map draws only nodes with geographic referents; traditional narratives and sacred sites belong to another layer.
researchNote: Departure, return, stop nodes, route variants and map sources still need to be added; this is an Alpha route skeleton.
